book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Yɨɨsu aragemwa na Shɨtaani
Akʉmara, Yɨɨsu akakangatwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu kuja mwitɨrɨgʉ korereke agemwe na Shɨtaani.
Akamara iyo sikʉ merongo ene, ubhutikʉ nu umwise ariiyima kurya ibhyakurya. Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, akiigwa ɨnzara.
Neho Shɨtaani akaaza komogema. Akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu, swaja amabhwɨ ganʉ gabhɨ ɨmɨkaatɨ.”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, ‘Ʉmʉʉtʉ atakwikara kwa bhyakurya ibhyene, nawe kwa amangʼana ganʉ gakurwa kwa Mungu.’
Akʉmara Shɨtaani akamuhira mʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉrɨndu rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu, akamwimiirirya kʉkɨkʉngʉ cha rihekaaru,
akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu, irekera haasɨ, kʉ kʉbha yandikirwɨ,

content.text: korereke amagʉrʉ gaazʉ gataaza kwitema kwibhwɨ.’

content: Nawe Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Yandikirwɨ, ‘Ʉtagema Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu waazʉ.’
Akʉmara, Shɨtaani akamuhira kosonga yɨ ɨkɨgʉrʉ ɨkɨrɨɨhu. Akamwerecha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa zɨɨsɨ zʉʉsi nu ubhuniibhi bhwazʉ,
akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉraanhigamɨrɨ na konsengera, nɨrakoha bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ.”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nuurwɨ hanʉ, Shɨtaani! Yandikirwɨ,
Neho Shɨtaani akamutiga hayo. Hayohayo bhamaraika bhakaaza kumwangarɨra.
Yɨɨsu aratanga emeremo jazɨ
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu iigwirɨ kʉbha Yoohana Ʉmʉbhatiizi abhʉhirwɨ mokebhoho, akaja mucharʉ cha Gariraaya.
Gariraaya iyo, akasaama Nazarɨɨti, akaja kwikara mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kapɨrinaumu. Kapɨrinaumu iri rusizʉ wɨ ɨnyanza ya Gariraaya, ʉrʉbhaara rwɨ ɨbhɨgambʉ bhya Zabhurʉʉni na Naafutaari.
Ɨkabhabhu, korereke rɨbhɨ ringʼana rɨnʉ Mungu aagambirɨ kʉhɨtɨra kwʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Isaaya,

content.text: “Mwitegeerere abhaatʉ bhi icharʉ cha Zabhurʉʉni na Naafutaari,
ahagero hanʉ harɨ kʉnzɨra yu ukwerekera kʉnyanza,
ni imwambʉkʉ wɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani,
mucharʉ cha Gariraaya ɨnʉ bhakwikara abhaatʉ bhi ibhyarʉ ɨbhɨndɨ.
na bhanʉ bhi ikɨɨrɨ mukikiriiri chu uruku,

content: Kwɨma ribhaga riyo, Yɨɨsu akatanga kurwazɨra abhaatʉ, “Mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwanyu, kʉ kʉbha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ bhʉraariirɨ!”
Yɨɨsu ararobhora abhɨɨga bhaazɨ
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ aragenda rusizʉ wɨ ɨnyanza ya Gariraaya, akarora abhahiiri bhabhɨrɨ, Simʉʉni wʉnʉ aabhirikiirwɨ Peetero na Andureya. Bhaarɨ bhararekera zenzero mʉnyanza kʉ kʉbha bhaarɨ abhawɨsɨni.
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Muntunɨ na niinyɨ nɨrabhakora kʉbha abhawɨsɨni bha abhaatʉ.”
Rogendo rʉmwɨ, bhakatiga zenzero zaabhʉ, bhakamutuna.

Hanʉ iisukirɨ embere hasuuhu, akarora abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhabhɨrɨ, Yaakobho na Yoohana umunyi waazɨ, abhaana bha Zebhedaayo. Bhaarɨ mubhwatʉ hamwɨmwɨ na wiisɨ, bharazomya zenzero zaabhʉ, akabhabhɨrɨkɨra.
Hayohayo bhakatiga wiisɨ nu ubhwatʉ, bhakamutuna.
Yɨɨsu ariija abhaatʉ na kohorya abharwɨrɨ
Yɨɨsu aarɨ ariiruguura mucharʉ chʉsi cha Gariraaya. Aarɨ arasikɨra mʉmarwazɨrʉ
na kwija abhaatʉ. Aarɨ ararwazɨra abhaatʉ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ na kohorya amarwɨrɨ gaabhʉ gʉʉsi.

Ɨngʼana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu ɨkanyaragana bhʉkʉngʼu kuhika mucharʉ chʉsi cha Siiriya. Abhaatʉ bhakahira abharwɨrɨ bhaabhʉ bhʉʉsi bha amarwɨrɨ ga zeteemwa zʉzʉʉsi bhaarɨ bharanyaakibhwa. Gatɨ waabhʉ, bhaarɨmu bha amasambwa amabhɨ, bha ririmu na bhanʉ bhakuurɨ ibhiimʉ, akabhahorya bhʉʉsi.
Mmbe, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakabha bharamutuna kurwa Gariraaya, Dɨkapʉʉri, Yɨrusarɨɨmu, Yudeya ni imwambʉkʉ wɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani.

footnotes.text: Amarwazɨrʉ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana rirwazɨrʉ muKiniibhasa.
